prompt: React vs Vue: which should I learn first?

plan.title: React vs Vue: Which Should You Learn First?
plan.description: A quick comparison of React and Vue for beginners choosing a first JavaScript framework. Learn what each offers and which to pick based on your goal.

beats.narration: React or Vue? Stop agonizing. Both teach you the same core ideas: components, state, and building screens from small reusable pieces.

props.text: React or Vue? Same core ideas.

beats.narration: Vue is gentler. Its clear structure and friendly docs help beginners. React has more jobs and a bigger ecosystem, but asks more of you.
Want a job fast? Learn React. Want an easy first win? Start with Vue. Either way, pick one and build something today.
